title: Brain Search Query v1
description: The brain_search query language: every argument the MCP tool accepts, published as a versioned JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). The same table derives the served tools/list inputSchema and the o2b search CLI flags; see $defs.search_query_document for the line-oriented query_document grammar.

query.description: What to recall from the vault. Matched against the index by keyword, semantics, or both.

query_document.description: Line-oriented query program with intent:, lex:, vec: and hyde: lanes, steering each retrieval layer separately. Absent means 'query' drives every lane.

focus_query.description: Steer this one call towards a working-set topic without persisting a session focus.

focus_path_prefix.description: Steer this one call towards a vault subtree, paired with focus_query as a transient focus.

focus_session.description: Session id whose bound focus applies (falls back to the global focus).

evidence_pack.description: Return the evidence pack: matched/missing terms, coverage, abstention text and the false-absence guard. Default false.

include_superseded.description: History mode for relation polarity: keep matched superseded predecessors undemoted and skip successor pull-in. Default false.

since.description: Hard filter on event time (validity, body anchor, mtime last): at/after this point. ISO date/datetime, today, yesterday, last week, last month, <n>h/<n>d/<n>w.

until.description: Hard filter on event time (validity, body anchor, mtime last): at/before this point. Same forms as 'since'.

limit.description: How many ranked results to return. Default 10.

semantic.description: Force the semantic lane on or off. Absent lets the configured hybrid strategy decide.

keyword_only.description: Skip the semantic lane entirely, so no embedding is needed. Default false.

match_mode.description: FTS match breadth: 'all' (default) requires every term; 'any' matches a document carrying any one term. Absent leaves the implicit AND.

disclosure.description: Result depth: 'full' (default) returns full chunk content; 'cards' returns token-cheap layer-1 cards — drill a hit with brain_search_expand.

profile.description: Named recall profile (fast|balanced|thorough): a fixed knob preset, preferred over persisted self-tuning. Absent leaves ranking unchanged.

explain.description: Add a per-result score_breakdown plus the retrieval_decision_trace and memory_trust_assessment receipts. Default false.

trust.description: Stamp each result with inline trust metadata (age_days, superseded, conflict), computed at read time. Default false.

threshold.description: Relevance floor in [0,1] on the final score; drops weaker hits so an irrelevant query returns no match. Default 0 (disabled).

rerank.description: Re-order the threshold-qualified results by core textual relevance (keyword + semantic). Default false.

reinforce.description: Paths proven useful: recorded to the reinforce ledger and lifted (bounded) before the top_k cut. Default absent.

record_access.description: Record the surfaced paths as one activation access event (feeds the usage-aware ranking layer). Default true; never recorded for global searches.

global.description: Cross-vault union: search profile vaults and read-only recall sources too, merging results with origin labels. Default false (active vault only).

path_prefix.description: Restrict results to this vault subtree. Absent searches the whole vault.

telemetry.description: Emit one recall-telemetry continuity record for this call. Default false.

telemetry_host.description: Optional host/client label recorded on the telemetry record.

session_id.description: Optional session correlation id recorded on the telemetry record.

turn_id.description: Optional turn correlation id recorded on the telemetry record.

properties.description: Optional frontmatter filter; values within a key OR, keys AND. type, pinned, visibility as indexed; other keys narrow on the attribute snapshot, judged live.

kind.description: Restrict candidates by chunk kind: 'page' matches each document's frontmatter/head chunk (chunk 0), 'section' everything after it. Absent searches all chunks.

degree.description: Graph-degree predicates over backlink/outlink counts, e.g. 'backlinks=0' (orphans) or 'outlinks>=5' (hubs); ANDed. Absent = no filter.

visibility.description: Optional content-visibility scope; untagged pages always match, tagged pages only when this scope includes one of their values.

agent_scope.description: Optional agent-ownership scope; shared (ownerless) pages always match, owner-tagged pages only their owner. Absent = no ownership filtering.

session_scope.description: Optional session-scope filter; pages with no session always match, session-tagged pages only this session. Absent = no session filtering.

project_scope.description: Optional project-scope filter; pages with no project always match, project-tagged pages only this project. Absent = no project filtering.

iterative.description: Opt in to the bounded iterative recall loop (default off). Surviving gaps pause with a plan; resume via iterative_payload. Inert unless the knob is on.

iterative_token.description: The round token from a plan-phase response, submitted beside iterative_payload. Requires iterative: true; single use - a replayed token is refused by name.

iterative_payload.description: Decider payload answering a plan-phase envelope: { evidence: [chunkId, ...], subQueries: [...] }, validated before any pull runs. Requires iterative_token.

search_query_document.title: Brain Search Query Document v1
search_query_document.description: Line-oriented query program steering each retrieval layer separately. One '<lane>: <value>' line per lane; blank lines and #-comments are ignored. At least one lane is required; the intent lane may appear at most once.

intent.description: Retrieval posture: neutral (default ranking), exact (verbatim phrase preference), entity (tightly scoped subject), broad (recall-favouring). At most one intent line.

lex.description: Keyword-lane tokens, space separated; quote a multi-word token. A leading '-' excludes the token. Repeatable: later lex lines add tokens.

vec.description: Embedding-lane query text. Repeatable: later vec lines add queries.

hyde.description: Hypothetical passage the answer would look like. Repeatable: later hyde lines add passages.
